returns.text:
Returns policy
Standard items can be returned within 30 days.
Custom-made items are not refundable.
Damaged items must be reported within 48 hours.

shipping.text:
Delivery guide
Domestic delivery takes 3–5 business days.
International delivery takes 10–15 business days.
Tracking is emailed after dispatch.
